_comment: E01 T28 committed perf baselines. Recorded by `cargo run --release -p lbx-perf`
on the M0 exit-drill machine (see below); the nightly workflow compares every
run against these. Semantics (tools/lbx-perf/src/report.rs): exceeding a
`budgets` entry is a REGRESSION (files the tracked issue, non-blocking per
spec §8); exceeding 2x a `scenarios` value is an advisory `watch` marker only,
because these numbers are machine-relative and CI runners differ. Re-bless by
re-running lbx-perf on comparable hardware and pasting the numbers here.
The `reference` block records dev-machine numbers the comparator ignores
(I/O-bound wall times, and the grid-scroll capture from `lightbox
--perf-scroll 300`, which runs windowed and is published separately).
machine: Apple M5 Max, macOS aarch64, Metal (E01 T29 drill machine)

grid-scroll.note: 120 Hz display; p50/p95 sit on the 8.3 ms vsync cadence
